title.es: Repaso de la gramática de B2

objective: Al terminar repasas y aplicas la gramática clave de B2: condicionales, pasivas, estilo indirecto, modales, inversión, oraciones escindidas y cláusulas de participio.

warmup.prompt_es: Antes del examen final, recorres de un vistazo la gramática más importante de B2. Cada bloque incluye la regla, un ejemplo y los errores más comunes para detectarlos tú mismo.

text: B2 grammar at a glance: a short quiz story
Last year, Tom was offered a job abroad. If he had accepted it immediately, he would have missed an important family event, so he asked for more time. It was decided that he would start in March.

He was told that the company had been looking for someone with his skills for months. Having read the contract carefully, he realised that he was required to relocate. 'I wish I had asked more questions,' he said later. 'If I had known, I would have negotiated a better salary.'
Never before had he felt so uncertain. It was his sister who convinced him to go. 'You should have trusted yourself earlier,' she said. 'You needn't have worried so much.'

In the end, Tom moved. Although he missed home, he gradually got used to his new life. Not only did he make new friends, but he also learned to enjoy cooking. Looking back, he doesn't regret his decision.
input.es: Gramática B2 de un vistazo: una pequeña historia-test. El año pasado le ofrecieron a Tom un trabajo en el extranjero. Si lo hubiera aceptado de inmediato, se habría perdido un acontecimiento familiar importante, así que pidió más tiempo. Se decidió que empezaría en marzo. Le dijeron que la empresa llevaba meses buscando a alguien con sus habilidades. Tras leer el contrato con atención, se dio cuenta de que estaba obligado a mudarse. 'Ojalá hubiera hecho más preguntas', dijo después. 'Si lo hubiera sabido, habría negociado un mejor sueldo.' Nunca antes se había sentido tan inseguro. Fue su hermana quien lo convenció de ir. 'Deberías haber confiado antes en ti mismo', dijo. 'No hacía falta que te preocuparas tanto.' Al final, Tom se mudó. Aunque echaba de menos su casa, poco a poco se acostumbró a su nueva vida. No solo hizo nuevos amigos, sino que también aprendió a disfrutar cocinando. Mirando atrás, no se arrepiente de su decisión.

md_es: **Mapa gramatical B2**
| Tema | Forma | Ejemplo |
| **Third conditional** | if + past perfect, would have + participio | *If he had known, he would have negotiated.* |
| **Mixed conditional** | if + past perfect, would + base | *If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer now.* |
| **Wish / if only** | wish + past (presente) / past perfect (pasado) | *I wish I had asked.* |
| **Passive (advanced)** | it is said / be + participio + to | *It was decided that…* · *He is said to be rich.* |
| **Reported speech** | retroceso de tiempos | *He told me the company had been looking…* |
| **Past modals** | should have / needn't have / could have | *You should have trusted yourself.* |
| **Formal obligation** | be required to / be permitted to | *He was required to relocate.* |
| **Inversion** | negativo + auxiliar + sujeto | *Never before had he felt so uncertain.* |
| **Cleft sentences** | It was … who/that … · What … is … | *It was his sister who convinced him.* |
| **Participle clauses** | -ing / -ed / having + participio | *Having read the contract, he realised…* |
| **Causative** | have/get + objeto + participio | *He had his contract checked.* |
**Estrategia de repaso**
1. Identifica el tiempo o estructura que el contexto exige (¿pasado hipotético? ¿opinión ajena? ¿obligación?).
2. Comprueba la forma completa: auxiliar + participio, preposición, orden.
3. Revisa los errores típicos: *if + would*, *wish + would have*, *suggest to*, *depend of*.
**Errores típicos de B2**
- ✘ *If he would have known, he would have negotiated.* → ✔ *If he had known, he would have negotiated.*
- ✘ *I wish I would have asked.* → ✔ *I wish I had asked.*
- ✘ *He said me that he was tired.* → ✔ *He told me that he was tired.*
- ✘ *Never he had felt so uncertain.* → ✔ *Never had he felt so uncertain.*
- ✘ *Having finished, the report was sent.* (sujeto distinto) → ✔ *Having finished the report, she sent it.*
- ✘ *It was decided to he start in March.* → ✔ *It was decided that he would start in March.*

**Ojo:** en una conditional, nunca *would* en la cláusula *if*. En *wish*, el verbo retrocede un tiempo. En participio inicial, el sujeto de la cláusula principal debe ser quien hace la acción del participio.
Pronunciación: *relocate* /ˌriːləʊˈkeɪt/ · *negotiate* /nɪˈɡəʊʃieɪt/ · *uncertain* /ʌnˈsɜːtn/ · *gradually* /ˈɡrædʒuəli/.
